page.overview:
Who is Aged Goblin?

The Aged Goblin worked at the British Gringotts Wizarding Bank in the 1990s after Voldemort fell in 1981 and later rose to power and took over the Ministry of Magic in 1998.

During Harry, Ron, and Hermione Granger's break-in of Gringotts Wizarding Bank, this goblin managed to see through the trio's disguise before they appeared before Bogrod, but was quickly petrified by Harry using the Full Body-Bind Curse.
